task_name: Desktop: run tracking, delivery on idle, run card and replay
description: Keryx Desktop web view. panelBus.ts: runInTerminal(command, origin?) with RunOrigin {sessionId, source: message|tool}; a RunTracker registry (setRunTracker) that gives a Run with an origin a runId; RunRequest {command, runId?}; runOpened/runFailed; runTabTitle. Markdown.tsx: RunSessionContext (set by the transcript) gives the code-block Run its session; Markdown outside a session has no origin. Transcript.tsx: sessionId prop provides the context; the execute tool card's Run passes source tool; a terminalRun block renders TerminalRunCard and starts a new agent turn label. TerminalPanel.tsx: a Run opens a new tab with ptyOpenCommand(cwd, command, runTabTitle(command), 80, 24) and writes into no tab; a start failure keeps the 'Could not run the command' toast and tells the tracker; a Run that mounts the panel opens only its own tab; a run tab opened before ptyList answered is kept. session/terminalRuns.ts (new, no React): createTerminalRuns(deps) keyed by runId with states starting|running|waiting|sent|sent-while-running|closed|start-failed|not-sent; exit -> ptyTail(tab, 200) -> capRunOutput (last 200 lines, then last 16 KiB of UTF-8 at a character boundary) -> one entry of exactly runId, command, state, exitCode, durationMs, output; delivery per session in seq order, 8 per prompt, only when keryx's initialize offered terminalResults (null while reconnecting = wait), busy refusal -> waiting and a retry after 1 s, refused -> not-sent with keryx's reason; close before exit -> closed, the later exit ignored; Send output now -> a running snapshot without exitCode, the later exit only updates the card; an exit before the tab id is known is kept. reducer.ts: TerminalRunItem/TerminalRunView/TerminalRunState, actions terminalRun (upsert by runId) and terminalSent (cards move to the end, parentTurn + 1); replayed user chunks with _meta.keryx.terminalResult draw a sent card (sent-while-running for a running snapshot) with no actions, _meta.keryx.terminalContinuation draws nothing. useAcpSession.ts: runTurn() is the shared turn core of sendPrompt and the new sendTerminalResults (session/prompt {sessionId, prompt:[{type:text,text:<display line>}], _meta:{keryx:{terminalResults}}}, no user bubble, delivered only when the session is held, initialized and has no turn or Telegram turn); l.terminalResults read from initialize._meta.keryx.terminalResults; the run store is registered as tracker and card API, listens to onPtyExit/onTabClosed, and flushes on every conversation change (before the user's queued prompts). TerminalRunCard.tsx + terminalRunBus.ts + styles/runs.css: the card (command, state in words, exit badge ok/failed, duration, collapsible text-only output, Show tab while the tab exists, Send output now while running and unsent). duration.ts: formatDuration moved out of Transcript.tsx for the card.

Markdown a session renders outside its transcript (the Activity panel's subagent texts, portaled into the side panel) has no run origin: Run there opens a tab but nothing is tracked or sent back. Giving the Activity panel the RunSessionContext would make those runs tracked too.

SidePanels.dom.test.tsx prints 7 React act() warnings for TerminalPanel (async ptyList/ptyOpen resolution after a sync act); the same 7 are in the base run. RunButton.dom.test.tsx avoids them with an async act around render.

assumptions: The run card's "Send output now" is shown only while the run is running, its process has not ended, its tab is open and nothing was sent; on a keryx without terminalResults the click makes the card 'not sent' at once and the later exit only shows the exit code.
A tool card's or delegate result's Markdown inside the transcript carries the shown session's origin like an agent message does (the context wraps the whole transcript).
After a busy refusal the session is asked again no sooner than 1 s later (and at its next turn end), so a turn the client cannot see cannot cause a tight loop of refused prompts.
The prompt's display text is a fixed line ('The result of a command run from the Run button.' / 'The results of N commands …'); keryx ignores it.
durationMs counts from the moment the panel reported the tab open to the exit (or the snapshot), rounded to whole milliseconds.

behavior_changes.description: When a result is delivered, its run card moves to the end of the transcript, so the agent's follow-up reply comes right after it, as a reload shows it (note, then reply). Without the move the reply would be glued onto the previous agent message, because keryx sends no message ids and no user bubble separates the turns.
alternatives: Keep the card where the Run was clicked and mark a turn boundary so the reply starts a new agent message below everything else

behavior_changes.description: Run results waiting for a session go out before prompts the user queued during the same turn (the results flush runs before the queue on every turn end).
alternatives: Send the user's queued prompt first and the results after its turn

behavior_changes.description: A 'Send output now' snapshot that still waits for the session's turn to end when the process exits is replaced by the exit's result (one entry per run, state exited with exit code and the fresh tail); a snapshot already sent is never replaced, the exit only updates the card.
alternatives: Send the snapshot as captured and show the exit only on the card

behavior_changes.description: When the output tail cannot be read after the exit (the tab was closed in between, or the host failed), the result is still sent with its exit code and the output '[the output could not be read: <host error>]', which the card also shows.
alternatives: Do not send the result and say so on the card

behavior_changes.description: Results keryx would refuse are not sent: a prompt keryx refuses before storing anything (invalid params, invalid request other than busy, unknown session, no provider) leaves its cards 'not sent: <keryx's message>' with no retry and no notice; a command longer than keryx's 4096 characters is tracked but its result is 'not sent: the command is longer than the 4096 characters keryx takes'. A failure after keryx stored the results (the follow-up turn failed) keeps the cards 'sent' and shows the error as a transcript notice, like any failed turn.
alternatives: Also show a notice for a refused prompt
Truncate an over-long command to 4096 characters and send it

behavior_changes.description: A Run that opens the terminal panel for the first time (no tabs yet) opens only the run tab; before, the panel started its own shell tab and typed the command into it. A run tab that opened before the panel's tab list answered is kept in the list.
alternatives: Keep the panel's own first shell tab next to the run tab

behavior_changes.description: Card wording the dispatch did not give: 'starting…' while the tab opens, 'output sent to the agent while it was running' for a snapshot, the exit badge 'exit N' (ok for 0, failed otherwise) or 'ended by a signal', the duration as the tool cards show it, and 'not sent: the command is longer than …' / 'not sent: <keryx's message>'. The dispatch's own phrases are used as given.
alternatives: No 'starting…' state shown (card appears once the tab is open)

behavior_changes.description: A result that becomes ready while keryx is restarting (no initialize answered on the new connection yet) waits instead of being marked not sent; once the new keryx answers, it is sent if that keryx offers terminalResults and marked 'not sent: this keryx does not take run results' otherwise. The matrix covers a window reload (runs lost) but not a keryx restart.
alternatives: Mark results not sent when the connection resets

behavior_changes.description: After a busy refusal the session is asked again no sooner than 1 s later (and at its next turn end).
alternatives: Retry only at the next observed turn end
